result.topic_en: A pen drawing of a network of intersecting curves (apparently the curves on which the real and imaginary parts of a polynomial vanish or are constant, with their meeting points marked), labelled by a later archivist as a figure for Gauss's 'Beiträge zur Theorie der algebraischen Gleichungen'.

methods.what: Graphical depiction of the curve systems of a complex polynomial (the curves where its real and imaginary parts vanish or are constant), as used in the topological proof of the fundamental theorem of algebra
